manualPolicy.derivative: [f(x+dx/2)-f(x-dx/2)]/dx; blank dx uses abs(x)*1e-5, or 1e-5 when x=0.
manualPolicy.integral: Composite Simpson rule with N=2*n and h=(b-a)/N; blank n uses 100; a<=x<=b.
manualPolicy.input: Numeric conditions only, including numeric fractions illustrated by guide; no arbitrary condition equations. Reuse expression while changing conditions. NORMAL only. Calculation clears X.

manualPolicy.guideIntegral: sqrt(1-X^2) from 0 to 1 with blank n; visually verified printed 0.785357562 (earlier OCR interpretation discarded).

limitations: Exact private arithmetic, discontinuity handling and maximum native work limits must remain scoped to measured cases; published manual formulas are not evidence for every edge case.
Historical derivative difference (0.57735027 vs 0.577350268) resolved in the 2026-10-08 bounded truncation profile. Exact private algorithms beyond measured cases remain unverified.

Web integration limit is 10000 Simpson pairs (20001 samples), 64 samples per animation frame, expression length capped at 1000. Native maximum n, cancellation timing, negative dx/reversed bounds and every discontinuity are unmeasured. Singular sampled points produce Error 2; unsampled discontinuities are not automatically diagnosed.
Numeric condition fractions use the existing stacked fraction display requested by the user; the native LCD uses inline fraction separators.
